boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Oklahoma-Norman Campus
boards.description: Ten currently documented Norman destinations with late-night or overnight availability, including one on-campus overnight building.

cards.title: Moe's Hot Chicken and Grill
cards.subtitle: 1915 Classen Blvd #113, Norman
cards.notes: Check the posted closing time before leaving: the official site lists daily service to 2 a.m., extending to 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Classen Boulevard food stop with hours reaching into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Moe's official site lists Norman hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Moe's Hot Chicken and Grill — Norman location and business hours
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 11 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Confirm holiday changes directly.

cards.title: Fat Shack Norman
cards.subtitle: 119 W Boyd Street, Suite 104, Norman
cards.notes: Use the official order page to confirm the night’s service. It lists pickup and delivery, with later Thursday–Saturday closing times.
cards.short_summary: A Boyd Street pickup or delivery option near the university area.
cards.evidence_claim: Fat Shack's Norman page lists hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and until 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday; 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday. Pickup and delivery are listed.

cards.title: Oklahoma Memorial Union
cards.subtitle: 900 Asp Avenue, OU Norman campus
cards.notes: For a late study break, use the building’s published access details: after midnight, students, faculty, and staff enter with a Sooner Card.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus building with continuous regular hours and controlled overnight entry.
cards.evidence_claim: OU states the Oklahoma Memorial Union is open 24 hours daily; after midnight, Sooner Card access is required at the South and East Entrances.
cards.source_title: Visit the OMU — University of Oklahoma
cards.access_notes: Regular hours are 24 hours daily. After midnight, building doors are locked; students, faculty, and staff may enter via South and East Entrances with a Sooner Card.

cards.title: Whataburger at Main & 24th
cards.subtitle: 2424 W Main Street, Norman
cards.notes: This is a 24-hour location on West Main. Check its official location page for any holiday-hour exception before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A West Main restaurant listing 24-hour dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists its 2424 W Main Street Norman location as 24 hours daily for dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery.
cards.access_notes: Official listing shows 24-hour dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery every day; it notes holiday hours might differ.

cards.title: Whataburger on Classen Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 2920 Classen Boulevard, Norman
cards.notes: The official listing reports 24-hour dine-in and drive-thru service. Verify the location page if a holiday or special closure is possible.
cards.short_summary: A Classen Boulevard restaurant documented as open around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists its 2920 Classen Boulevard Norman location as 24 hours daily for dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery.
cards.access_notes: Official listing shows 24-hour dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery daily.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Lindsey Street
cards.subtitle: 2125 W Lindsey Street, Norman
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when arriving after the dining room closes. The official page lists service to 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A West Lindsey drive-thru with posted early-morning closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 2125 W Lindsey Street.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2125 W Lindsey Street, Norman
cards.access_notes: Posted drive-thru hours: until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours are separately listed.

cards.title: Taco Bell on 12th Avenue NE
cards.subtitle: 1101 12th Avenue NE, Norman
cards.notes: Plan for drive-thru service if it is after the dining room’s listed hours. The official page posts 2 a.m. closings, with 3 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A northeast Norman location with late drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 1101 12th Avenue NE.
cards.access_notes: Posted drive-thru hours: until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in hours are shorter.

cards.title: Taco Bell on 24th Street NW
cards.subtitle: 1024 24th Street NW, Norman
cards.notes: The official page lists this location’s drive-thru as open 24 hours. For a late run, confirm the drive-thru rather than assuming dining-room access.
cards.short_summary: A 24th Street NW restaurant with a 24-hour posted drive-thru.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists the drive-thru at 1024 24th Street NW as open 24 hours every day; dine-in hours are separately listed.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed as open 24 hours daily. The dining room has different, shorter posted hours.

cards.title: IHOP on Ed Noble Parkway
cards.subtitle: 840 Ed Noble Parkway, Norman
cards.notes: This official location page lists 24-hour service plus dine-in, curbside pickup, online ordering, takeout, and delivery options.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour IHOP south of the core campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 840 Ed Noble Parkway Norman restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day and identifies dine-in, takeout, delivery, and curbside pickup.

cards.title: IHOP on 12th Avenue NE
cards.subtitle: 1049 12th Avenue NE, Norman
cards.notes: The official page lists this northeast Norman restaurant as open 24 hours and includes dine-in, curbside pickup, takeout, and delivery.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 1049 12th Avenue NE Norman restaurant as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours every day and identifies dine-in, takeout, delivery, and curbside pickup.
